test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a volcano?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mount Blanc__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mont Blanc** is the highest mountain in the Alps and Western Europe, with a **height of 4,807.81 m.**
 
• A cable car travels across the mountain range from Courmayeur to Chamonix.
 
• It is the second-most prominent mountain in **Europe, after Mount Elbrus.**
 
• It is the **eleventh most prominent mountain in all over the world.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mount Vesuvius** is a stratovolcano which is located in the **Gulf of Naples in Campania, Italy.**
 
• **Mount Etna**, or Etna, is an active stratovolcano on the east coast of **Sicily, Italy**, in the **Metropolitan City of Catania.**
 
• **Cotopaxi** is an active stratovolcano in the** Andes Mountains, located in Latacunga city of Cotopaxi Province**
